text:
kevin: Heads-up — we started seeing a regression tied to CUDA/driver combos in marketplace images. ~10% of customer startup jobs either OOM or hit kernel init failures. Suspect recent driver 536.x roll on some images. @nvidia-partner can you confirm? :warning:

jia: Can you paste a sample log?

kevin: sure:
```
ERROR: failed to allocate 0x1e0000000: out of memory
E CudaDriver: driver version mismatch: expected 535.86 but found 536.02
stack: launch failed on kernel init
```

nvidia-partner: Thanks for the report. We pushed a micropatch (536.03) addressing a kernel reorder issue, but we can also provide a compatibility build that aligns with 535.86 behavior. We can produce a 535-compat driver tag for marketplace images. ETA for signed artifact and manifest is ~48 hours.

olivia: For the marketplace we should avoid breaking churn. Suggest immediate image pin to the last-known-good driver (535.86) for new marketplace images and start a canary lane for the patched driver. That buys time for partner patch rollout.

mike: We have two deployment lanes available: strict-pin (block new uploads with 536.x) and compat-fallback (accept 536.x but redirect to compat runtime). Proposal: enable strict-pin for default marketplace image builds, create a canary deploy (10% traffic) for 536.03, auto-rollback on error spike. I'll open the PR to pin tags and add canary config.

release-bot: deployment scheduled: marketplace-images/pinning-2026-03-22 @ 03:00 UTC — release candidate rc-20260322-01 created by mike.

jia: Quick question: are we seeing anything similar on ROCm stacks or only CUDA/driver combos? Need to scope communications to partners + SI.

nvidia-partner: ROCm ecosystem hasn't reported the same symptom from our side. This appears to be a CUDA driver/kernel ordering regression. That said, some SI-custom kernels could surface similar failures; we'll share a compatibility matrix and guidance link: https://partners.nvidia.com/compat/536-patch-notes (internal).

olivia: Also we need partner-facing comms: a joint advisory + one-pager for systems integrators explaining temporary pin and rollout plan. @mike can you draft the advisory and coordinate with marketplace legal?

mike: Yep. Draft in 6h, legal + sales review within 12h. I'll include sample messaging for enterprise customers and the rollback procedure.

kevin: I'll own the hotfix runbook and ops checklist. Tentative steps:
1) Pin marketplace base images to nv-driver-535.86 tag
2) Create canary lane at 10% for nv-driver-536.03 micropatch
3) Monitor error rate + OOM signals for 30m windows, auto-rollback threshold 2x baseline
4) Distribute signed artifact from partner and schedule customer-facing patch notes
5) Coordinate private deployment guidance (VPC/on-prem) for customers who manage their own drivers
I'll take runbook ownership and update the Confluence playbook.

nvidia-partner: We'll provide the signed 535-compat artifact and manifest, and mark the change as non-security (no CVE), ETA artifact delivery ~36-48h. We'll also include a short checklist for SI integration points (kernel flags, ABI pin).

olivia: Great — call to align? 10:00am PT today for a quick 20m sync? :thumbsup:

mike: Works for me. I'll send calendar invite and attach the PR + initial advisory draft.

jia: I'll add GPU matrix tests to the QA run for the canary (A100, H100, T4) and validate both strict-pin and compat paths.

kevin: Thanks everyone. If anything changes from the partner side post-artifact delivery, ping here.

nvidia-partner: Noted — will update in-channel when artifacts are published.
